skill.name: Spirit Rush
skill.description: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, damaging nearby enemies. Spirit Rush can be cast up to three times before going on cooldown, and gains additional recasts when taking down enemy champions.

skill.name: Charm
skill.description: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and charms an enemy it encounters, instantly stopping movement abilities and causing them to walk harmlessly towards her.

skill.name: Calibrum · Moonshot
skill.description:
Aphelios has 5 different activated abilities, based on his main-hand weapon:

Calibrum (Rifle): Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack.
Severum (Scythe Pistol): Run fast while attacking nearby enemies with both weapons.
Gravitum (Cannon): Root all enemies slowed by this weapon.
Infernum (Flamethrower): Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your off-hand weapon.
Crescendum (Chakram): Deploy a sentry that shoots your off-hand weapon.

skill.name: Severum
skill.description:
Aphelios has 5 different activated abilities, based on his main-hand weapon:

Calibrum (Rifle): Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack.
Severum (Scythe Pistol): Run fast while attacking nearby enemies with both weapons.
Gravitum (Cannon): Root all enemies slowed by this weapon.
Infernum (Flamethrower): Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your off-hand weapon.
Crescendum (Chakram): Deploy a sentry that shoots your off-hand weapon.

skill.name: Hallowed Mist
skill.description: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

skill.name: Pierce
skill.description: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.

skill.name: Mimic
skill.description: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.

skill.name: Ethereal Chains
skill.description: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

skill.name: Tempest / Cripple
skill.description:
Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple.
Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.

skill.name: Soaring Slam
skill.description: Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If cast while Rammus is in Powerball, Rammus knocks up enemies near the center as well.

passive.name: Spiked Shell
passive.description: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.

skill.name: Powerball
skill.description: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

skill.name: Defensive Ball Curl
skill.description: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, and returning damage to enemies that attack him.

skill.name: Frenzying Taunt
skill.description: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him.

skill.name: Destiny
skill.description: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.

skill.name: Stacked Deck
skill.description: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.

passive.name: Deathbringer Stance
passive.description: Periodically, Aatrox's next basic attack deals bonus <physicalDamage>physical damage</physicalDamage> and heals him, based on the target's max health.

skill.name: Umbral Dash
skill.description: Passively, Aatrox heals when damaging enemy champions. On activation, he dashes in a direction.

skill.name: Between Worlds
skill.description: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.

skill.name: Endless Banquet
skill.description: Bel'Veth consumes Void coral remnants, transforming into her true form and increasing her max health, attack range, attack speed, and out-of-combat move speed. Consuming the Void coral remnants of a Void epic monster will grant her a longer ultimate duration, as well as the power to summon Void remora.

skill.name: Judgment
skill.description: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

passive.name: Relentless Assault
passive.description: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

skill.name: Obliterate
skill.description: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.

skill.name: Blooming Burst
skill.description: Neeko throws a seed dealing magic damage. The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units.

skill.name: Shapesplitter
skill.description: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack, briefly increasing her move speed. Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction and recast to change the direction of the clone.

skill.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
skill.description: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with Attack Speed for a short duration. As a cougar, she claws in a direction, dealing damage to enemies in front of her.

skill.name: Flamespitter
skill.description: Rumble torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds. While in Danger Zone this damage is increased.

skill.name: Electro Harpoon
skill.description: Rumble launches a harpoon, electrocuting his target with magic damage, slowing their Move Speed, and reducing their Magic Resist. Rumble can carry 2 harpoons at a time. While in Danger Zone the damage and slow percentage is increased.

passive.name: Daredevil Impulse
passive.description: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by <status>Immobilizing</status> effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is <status>Knocked Up</status>, she also keeps them <status>Knocked Up</status> briefly.

skill.name: Flair
skill.description: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion.

passive.name: Absolution
passive.description:
When units die near Senna, their souls are periodically trapped by the Black Mist. Senna can attack these souls to free them, absorbing the Mist that held them in death. Mist fuels her Relic Cannon's power with increased Attack Damage, Attack Range, and Critical Strike Chance.

Attacks from Senna's Relic Cannon take longer to fire, deal bonus damage, and briefly grant her a portion of her target's Move Speed.

skill.name: Shadow Dash
skill.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

skill.name: Threaded Volley
skill.description: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.

skill.name: Denting Blows
skill.description: Vi's punches break her opponent's Armor, dealing bonus damage and granting her Attack Speed.

skill.name: Relentless Force
skill.description: Vi's next attack blasts through her target, dealing damage to enemies behind it.

passive.name: Shepard of Souls
passive.description: <font color='#FF9900'>The Cursed Horde:</font> Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.

skill.name: Last Rites
skill.description: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.

skill.name: Lightning Crash
skill.description: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity and overcharges herself, gaining increased damage and stacking Move Speed that refreshes and gets stronger every time she hits an enemy champion. While overcharged, Burst fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains lightning between enemies.
